description: Traffic volumes on links in the highway network is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Alberta | Gouvernement de l'Alberta. Each annual issue of this dataset contains data on average daily traffic, vehicle classifications, million vehicle-kilometres and equivalent single axle loadings travelled on Alberta's highways. The data are given as weighted averages over entire highways, control sections and traffic control sections. Coverage: Government of Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Alberta | Gouvernement de l'Alberta. Its tags are ESAL, equivalent single axle loading, highway control sections, highway equivalent single axle loading, highways. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-04-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
